description.value: Italian Kitchen is a full-service Italian restaurant in downtown Vancouver, part of the Glowbal Restaurant Group, centered on handmade pastas, antipasti platters, and shareable Italian dishes under an 'Old World Charm, New World Vibe' philosophy. Located on Burrard Street, the restaurant regularly showcases local ingredients such as seasonal spot prawns and hosts specialty dining events including chef-led pasta making experiences and themed regional Italian dinners.
